candidates.statement: Order service postgres save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the client connection pool is fully saturated (size 5, idle 0), causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders, and 502 checkout responses.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side traces/logs/metrics were excluded from context, so pool saturation is inferred only from gateway spans; postgres server-side state unconfirmed.

report.explanation: All four checkout 502s trace to gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders; order spans show postgres save_order DependencyUnavailable with pool size 5 and idle 0, while inventory and payment succeed. This bounds the fault to order's postgres dependency, consistent with db-pool-exhaustion. Order-side telemetry was excluded, so confidence is moderate.
